review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved both boolean flags, empty fields, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise natural Greek, correct item agreement, clear culture-specific hat names, and retention of the source's humor and visual details.
